instruction: I watch foreign movies on VLC and I prefer using external subtitle files. However, VLC doesn't automatically load subtitle files that are in the same folder as the video. Can you disable the automatic subtitle detection feature?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling VLC's automatic subtitle detection feature. The evaluator checks if the 'sub-autodetect-file' setting in VLC configuration is set to 0 (disabled). This is similar to the original task which modifies VLC settings.
